title: BCG X NAMR Staffing Coordinator – X Delivery (Temporary, 6-Month Contract)
description:

What You'll Do
We are seeking a strong candidate with experience and passion to join BCG X as NAMR Staffing Specialist located in Sao Paulo.
 
As Staffing Specialist, you will apply deep knowledge of talent profiles and client business needs to make key staffing decisions across multiple disciplines. This role will have a focus on BCG X and X Delivery topics. In this role, you will collaborate with chapter leads and leads of BCG X, general managers, and the wider staffing team assigning talent to sold work and new business efforts. You will provide strategic staffing recommendations based on understanding of talent skill sets, teaming insights, and commercial priorities. You will have a pulse on how employees are deployed to projects and use that knowledge to optimize solving resource requests for forecasted projects.
 
*Key responsibilities include:*
* Responsible for optimizing deployment of BCG X resources to meet the needs of our business while ensuring each person receives opportunities supporting their Career Development objectives and long-term professional goals
* Maintain an acute awareness of the business environment and priorities; understand objectives of client/cases and openly communicate information relative to project opportunities with individuals while engaging with senior stakeholders and team leadership on staff portfolio
* Build strong relationships with BCG X talent to understand developmental needs and preferences for staffing; discuss upcoming projects; advise on staffing choices to achieve balance between business needs and personal preferences when possible; communicate staffing decisions and related rationale; set and enforce staffing policies and expectations
* Create visibility on current/planned resource allocation, considering diversity implications when staffing projects and teams holistically; ensuring fairness and equity with lens on people with different backgrounds and experiences
* Ensure relevant tools and trackers are maintained providing visibility of people commitments such project assignments, training and time off requests. Participate in the ongoing improvement of our staffing processes and systems
* Provide input to BCG local HR and relevant stakeholders on employee matters when required
* Work with Regional People & Development stakeholders to provide career support and guidance around mobility programs including alignment with key stakeholders prior to approving mobility or other employee programs.
* Collaborate with Finance and ensure that financial approvals are considered and cooperate with finance in ensuring correct financial allocation of assigned resources
* Provide input to rest of staffing and HR team to maintain up to date accurate information on staff including project assignments, training, recruiting and time off 
* You will help business teams understand HR policies, tools and resolve complex queries. Coordinate with BCG X ops team to maintain the HR database on internal systems, and keep it updated.
*YOU’RE GOOD AT*
* Performing successfully in a fast-paced, global, intellectually intense, service-oriented environment, keeping with BCG's values and culture
* Having excellent interpersonal skills, ability to communicate with all organizational levels inside and outside BCG through establishing positive and productive working relationships
* Having strong communication skills; able to communicate with confidence
* Being a proactive problem solver, ability to influence multiple stakeholders in a new point of view and be simultaneously flexible with adjusting own perspective considering new information or constraints
* Having high integrity, tact, a positive attitude, and an ability to maintain absolute confidentiality
* Being comfortable resolving conflict, delivering difficult messages and addressing all people related issues; excellent judgment and knows when to escalate
* Being an active team player, autonomous, able to manage ambiguity and self-motivated

What You'll Bring
* 2-3 years’ experience in professional services and / or technology services environment, preferably in a staffing, workforce planning, people, or recruiting functions
* Bachelor's degree required
* Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills

Who You'll Work With
You will work in BCG X Staffing Team and will collaborate with local BCG staffing and finance team to monitor billability, timesheet accuracy and work closely with the HR and Recruiting teams on talent strategies. You will build relationships and work effectively with members of billable and BST talent, Global X staffers, CDC, and the X NAMR leadership team.

Additional info
BCG X is the tech build & design unit of BCG. Turbocharging BCG’s deep industry and functional expertise, BCG X brings together advanced tech knowledge and ambitious entrepreneurship to help organizations enable innovation at scale. With nearly 3,000 technologists, scientists, programmers, engineers, and designers located across 80+ cities, BCG X builds and designs platforms and software to address the world’s most important challenges and opportunities. Teaming across our practices, and in close collaboration with our clients, our end-to-end global team unlocks new possibilities. Together we’re creating the bold and disruptive products, services, and businesses of tomorrow.

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and unlock their greatest opportunities. Our Legal team is a trusted advisor to the business, protecting the firm, enabling growth and helping teams move confidently in complex environments.
 
We operate at pace, in a global and increasingly technology-enabled environment. We are looking for a commercial lawyer who combines deep contracting expertise with strong commercial judgment and confident use of AI and digital tools.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Lead complex commercial contracting
* Draft, review, negotiate and advise on a broad range of commercial agreements, including client services agreements, vendor contracts, technology and SaaS arrangements, licensing, NDAs, subcontractor agreements and strategic partnerships.
* Provide clear, pragmatic and commercially aligned advice that balances business objectives with legal integrity.
* Identify legal and commercial risk early, articulate implications clearly and recommend practical mitigation strategies.
Champion contracting standards and scalable solutions
* Drive consistency and efficiency across contracting processes.
* Embed appropriate legal guardrails into commercial workflows and standards.
* Move beyond one-off advice to system-level improvements that reduce repeat risk.
Use AI and technology responsibly to enhance legal delivery
* Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, assess risks, contract review, drafting and synthesis.
* Structure inputs thoughtfully and critically assess outputs to ensure accuracy, defensibility and tone.
* Understand and manage risks associated with AI use, including confidentiality, bias and reliability.
* Identify opportunities to scale legal support through automation, knowledge tools and repeatable workflows.
Operate as a strategic cross-functional partner
* Partner closely with Finance, Procurement, Risk, Compliance, Technology and business leadership.
* Translate complex legal concepts into practical guidance that enables confident decision-making.
* Anticipate second-order operational and reputational impacts of commercial decisions.
* Contribute to broader governance discussions, including responsible AI use and regulatory developments.
Contribute to team capability and innovation
* Support knowledge sharing, training and development within the Legal team.
* Help modernise how Legal delivers value through expertise, process improvement and technology adoption.
* Foster a culture of sound judgment, responsiveness and continuous improvement.
What Success Looks Like
* Commercial contracts negotiated efficiently with clear risk positioning and strong commercial alignment.
* Legal advice that is precise, practical and trusted by senior stakeholders.
* Reduced cycle times and improved quality through scalable templates and AI-enabled workflows.
* Strong cross-functional relationships built on credibility and sound judgment.
* Demonstrable impact on risk mitigation and operational clarity across the business.
* Responsible and effective integration of AI tools into day-to-day legal delivery.

What You'll Bring
* Qualified lawyer with significant post-qualification experience in commercial contracting (typically 5+ years).
* Strong experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements in a global or multinational environment.
* Commercially minded, pragmatic and comfortable balancing risk with business objectives.
* Confident user of AI and legal technology tools, with a clear understanding of their capabilities and limitations.
* Excellent analytical, drafting and negotiation skills.
* Clear communicator who can influence and challenge constructively at senior levels.
* High personal integrity, discretion and sound professional judgment.
* Experience in professional services, technology or a complex corporate environment preferred.
* Full professional proficiency in English and Portuguese is required; proficiency in Spanish is considered a plus.

· Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred)
· Fluency in English and Portuguese
· Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities

TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer


LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil

R&D Manager

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. Responsibilities and Authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.

Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.


Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.


Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.


Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.


Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.


Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.


Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.


Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

description:
Procurando um desafio?


Seja em terra ou no mar, você encontra esse desafio na Edison Chouest Offshore . Somos uma família de empresas voltadas para resultados e apaixonadas pela excelência. Estamos orgulhosos do mosaico de pessoas que nos torna o fornecedor líder mundial de serviços marítimos.


A Bram Offshore Transportes Marítimos é uma empresa do Grupo Edison Chouest Offshore e especializada no transporte marítimo de apoio à indústria de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração.


Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time Offshore ?


Pré-requisitos:

  • 2ON - II/1;
  • DP - Básico/Avançado/Full;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • CIR válida;
  • Todos os certificados 1031 e 1034 válidos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Preparar o Passadiço para a viagem;
  • Executar a navegação, de acordo com as ordens do Comandante, avisando-o, imediatamente, de qualquer ocorrência que afete a segurança da navegação, assim como qualquer anormalidade que, a qualquer momento, ocorra;
  • Garantir de que as publicações náuticas e mapas estejam corretos e atualizados corretamente;
  • Garantir que os planos de navegação sejam verificados;
  • Garantir que as exigências documentais sejam atendidas;
  • Garantir que o equipamento da embarcação esteja pronto para operação;
  • Ser encarregado de sinais e bandeiras, devidamente inventariado, artefatos pirotécnicos, lâmpadas, lanternas e outros sinais de emergência;
  • Ser encarregado de os equipamentos de segurança e salvatagem e do bote de resgate, bem como seus dispositivos de lançamento;
  • Ser encarregado de todo o material de controle de avarias e incêndio, em qualquer parte da embarcação;
  • Assessorar o Comandante ou Imediato nas manobras de aproximação, amarração, atracação de desatracação.


Benefícios BRAM Offshore :

  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco - Acomodação Quarto (coparticipação de 20% para consulta e exames simples);
  • Dental Bradesco - (com opção de Upgrade);
  • Alelo Alimentação;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Previdência Privada com Match de 5% da empresa;
  • Ajuda Locomoção;
  • Plataforma de cursos online para todos os colaboradores;
  • Benefício de Academias e Plataforma de Incentivo a rotina saudável.

title: Coordenador de Pré Vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) para liderar a operação de pré-vendas da EQI. Essa liderança será responsável por garantir a produtividade e a performance do time de pré-vendas (SDRs), além de estruturar processos, ferramentas e rotinas que aumentem a previsibilidade e a qualidade do funil comercial. Será peça-chave na conexão entre estratégia e execução, atuando em conjunto com nosso time de marketing e vendas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Liderar e desenvolver o time de SDRs, garantindo metas de geração e qualificação;
  • Criar planos de ação, gerenciar SLAs, acompanhar execução e propor ajustes para otimizar a operação;
  • Conduzir 1:1s, rituais de acompanhamento, feedbacks estruturados e treinamentos contínuos;
  • Ser responsável pelo onboarding, rampagem e desenvolvimento técnico/comportamental dos SDR;
  • Implementar, aprimorar e padronizar processos comerciais, cadências, playbooks e rotinas do time;


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência prévia liderando times de SDR, Inside Sales ou operações comerciais;
  • Capacidade analítica para leitura de funil e tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Boa comunicação, perfil proativo e visão estratégica de negócios;

Domínio de Excel e familiaridade com análises de daschbords

  • Disponibilidade para atuar em Florianópolis/SC


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com uso de Salesforce;
  • Vivência em estruturar ou escalar operações de pré-vendas.


O que oferecemos:

️ Wellhub

PPR anual

Auxílio Creche

title: Cientista de Desenvolvimento de Produtos III
description:
Descrição das Atividades:


  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e a comercialização de projetos de média a alta complexidade para desenvolver e comercializar inovações para produtos e processos novos e renovados, além de iniciativas de redução de custos;
  • Executar atividades de desenvolvimento de produtos e processos de média a alta complexidade, desde a concepção até a comercialização;
  • Identificar com precisão os requisitos do projeto, aplicando a capacidade de produção, os ingredientes, a formulação e o design adequados para atender às necessidades dos clientes, às especificações do produto e às metas financeiras;
  • Realizar avaliações sensoriais internas, aplicações de produtos e testes de validade para determinar a aceitabilidade de protótipos e produtos competitivos para clientes e consumidores;
  • Seguir as diretrizes e protocolos estabelecidos, abordagem científica e análise estatística no desenvolvimento de produtos, testes em fábricas, inicialização de fábricas, estudos sensoriais, estudos de estabilidade de validade, estudos de capacidade e desenvolvimento de especificações;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico para resolver problemas de média á alta complexidade relacionadas à produção e qualidade, identificando a causa raiz, desenvolvendo e implementando soluções, incluindo treinamento de pessoal de controle de qualidade/operações sobre as conclusões dentro da categoria de produto atribuída;
  • Apoiar um ambiente que promova a inovação, introduzindo continuamente ideias e conceitos de produtos para novos produtos, melhorias de qualidade e produtividade e facilitar a tomada de riscos calculados;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a implementação da estratégia de matérias-primas em colaboração com o grupo da cadeia de abastecimento e fornecedores externos para obter um desempenho diferenciado dos novos produtos e qualidade ou redução de custos;
  • Desenvolver uma estratégia de matérias-primas em colaboração com o grupo da cadeia de abastecimento e fornecedores externos para obter um desempenho diferenciado dos novos produtos e qualidade;
  • Fornecer avaliações/perspectivas de risco técnico e comercial relacionadas com o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e atividades técnicas de gestão da marca;
  • Liderar, treinar e orientar técnicos;
  • Fornecer aconselhamento técnico a outros dentro da especialidade;


Experiências Anteriores:


  • Experiência comprovada na aplicação de normas técnicas, princípios, teorias, conceitos e interpretação de dados através de projetos experimentais sólidos e análises estatísticas (experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos e/ou processos alimentares, desde a concepção até a comercialização);
  • Sólido conhecimento em informática (Excel, Word, bancos de dados, software estatístico) e capacidade de criar planilhas, análises computacionais e relatórios;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de software relevantes (por exemplo, PLM, etc.). Capacidade de usar bancos de dados, software de apresentação e gerenciamento de projetos será um diferencial;


Formação Acadêmica:


  • Mestrado e/ou Doutorado em Ciência Alimentar, Química/Alimentar/Biológica ou áreas relacionadas;


Perfil Comportamental:


  • Foco em alcançar os objetivos do projeto e entregar resultados significativos;
  • Manter a responsabilidade pelos prazos e padrões de qualidade;
  • Adaptabilidade e resiliência: Confortável em lidar com ambiguidades, mudanças, prioridades e incertezas;
  • Lidar com riscos e desafios inesperados com serenidade e mentalidade voltada para a resolução de problemas;
  • Pensamento inovador: introduz continuamente novas ideias e conceitos para melhorias e inovação de produtos;
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe: trabalha de forma eficaz em ambientes multifuncionais;
  • Estabelecer relações sólidas com equipes internas e parceiros externos (fornecedores, instituições);
  • Comunicação e influência: comunica-se de forma clara e persuasiva em diferentes níveis da organização. Influencia decisões e alinha as partes interessadas em direção a objetivos comuns;
  • Liderança e orientação: Lidera e treina técnicos, fornecendo orientação e suporte técnico. Atua como um modelo de excelência técnica e comportamento profissional;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e pensamento analítico: Aplica projetos experimentais e análises estatísticas sólidas. Mantém a precisão na documentação, interpretação de dados e conformidade;
  • Orientação para o cliente e os negócios: Compreende as necessidades dos clientes e as traduz em soluções técnicas. Equilibra decisões técnicas com considerações financeiras e comerciais;


Benefícios:


  • Vale Alimentação, pago inclusive nas férias;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Gympass/Wellhub;
  • Day Off Aniversário;
  • Horário de Trabalho: Segunda á Quinta de 08:00 ás 18:00 e Sexta das 08:00 ás 17:00 hrs;

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil & gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.

Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.

Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.

**Candidate must be located in Joinville, Santa Catarina**

We are looking for a talented, communicative, and highly driven Senior Account Executive  to join our team at  Syndigo . In this role,  you’ll serve as a trusted partner to our clients—managing relationships, driving consultative sales, resolving issues, and supporting questions throughout the customer lifecycle. We value professionals who are agile, proactive, and passionate about delivering exceptional solutions.

HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY

  • Manage the full consultative sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.  
  • Actively  identify  and engage potential customers to build a strong pipeline.  
  • Lead regular meetings with suppliers and clients to introduce  new solutions  and strengthen relationships.  
  • Conduct  timely  and  accurate  follow‑ups based on sales funnel stages.
  • Prepare, present, and deliver high‑quality commercial proposals.  
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms to successfully close opportunities.  
  • Maintain an organized schedule and ensure all lead/client information is accurately updated in the CRM.  
  • Lead retention discussions and negotiate solutions with suppliers at risk of  churn .  
  • Participate in onsite client visits as needed.  
  • Represent  Syndigo  at trade shows, fairs, and other industry events.  
  • Identify  opportunities to improve internal processes, product offerings, or customer experience.

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU 

  • 4+ years of relevant experience  
  • Bachelor’s degree  
  • Advanced English and Brazilian Portuguese  proficiency  
  • Proven experience in commercial sales roles  
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills  
  • Strong technical  proficiency   (Microsoft 365)  
  • Effective problem-solving, planning, and  organization  abilities
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.

Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth! 

GDPR/CCPA

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice .

Descrição da Empresa

A ContabilizaEcom é uma empresa de contabilidade especialmente voltada para o e‑commerce, que combina expertise fiscal, tributária e empresarial para apoiar lojas online no Brasil.

Alguns destaques da empresa:

  • Foi criada por quem “nasceu em um e‑commerce”, ou seja, compreende os desafios práticos desse tipo de negócio.
  • Oferece serviços como abertura de empresa, análise fiscal de produtos, configuração de ERP e canais de venda, recuperação de impostos pagos indevidamente, planejamento tributário e busca de benefícios fiscais.
  • Foca em economia de impostos, segurança jurídica e regularização fiscal dos seus clientes.
  • Tem métricas que demonstram credibilidade: mais de 300 sellers ativos, cerca de 96% de satisfação dos clientes e mais de R$ 10 milhões em impostos economizados.


Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos procurando um Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP) para se juntar à equipe da ContabilizaEcom em Curitiba. Este cargo envolve a execução de tarefas diárias relacionadas a folha de pagamento no setor de departamento pessoal que busque a garantia de conformidade com as leis trabalhistas e legais vigentes.


Este é um cargo de tempo integral presencial, permitindo algumas atividades administrativas realizadas remotamente, onde o colaborador tem espaço para o crescimento em um ambiente descontraído com limites e responsabilidades.


Qualificações acadêmicas esperadas e atribuições da função


  • Formação: Graduação cursando ou completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Processamento da Folha: Executar o cálculo mensal da folha de pagamento, garantindo a exatidão de salários, descontos e proventos.
  • Cálculo de Encargos: Calcular e conferir o INSS, FGTS e IRRF.
  • Fechamento e Conferência: Realizar o fechamento da folha e emitir os relatórios de conferência (holerites), assegurando a conformidade legal.
  • Emissão de Guias: Gerar e enviar as guias de recolhimento dos encargos sociais e impostos (Ex: DAF, GPS/DARF Previdenciário).
  • Rotinas de Pessoal: executar cálculo e registro de férias e processamento de rescisões contratuais, com o devido registro no sistema.
  • Obrigações Acessórias: Realizar o lançamento e acompanhamento dos eventos mensais e periódicos no eSocial, garantindo a qualidade e o envio das informações.
  • Atendimento: Prestar suporte e esclarecimento de dúvidas aos colaboradores sobre holerites, benefícios e questões trabalhistas básicas.


Competências Comportamentais


  • Organização.
  • Habilidades de análise.
  • Proatividade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para integrar nosso time responsável pela evolução de uma plataforma Data Lakehouse na AWS .   • Construir e otimizar modelos analíticos em Amazon Redshift , garantindo performance e custo.
  • Publicar e manter datasets confiáveis para Power BI , incluindo gateways, incremental refresh, agregações e uso eficiente de DirectQuery/Import.
  • Colaborar com analistas e times de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em datasets, KPIs e camadas consumíveis, além de documentar catálogos e contratos de dados.


Requisitos e qualificações


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em AWS : S3, Glue Data Catalog, Airflow (preferencialmente MWAA), DAGs em Python, Amazon Redshift.
  • Linguagens: Python e SQL avançado .
  • Power BI : modelagem semântica, DAX, incremental refresh, gateway, boas práticas para consumo de Redshift.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura Data Lakehouse , formatos colunares (Parquet), partições e metadados.
  • Boas práticas de engenharia: Git, testes, code reviews, documentação, pipelines confiáveis.
  • Segurança e governança: IAM, criptografia, princípios de mínimo privilégio, LGPD aplicada a dados.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

description:
Mission Description:

Join our Advanced Analytics team as a Data Scientist in the Commercial Performance Tower. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning models that drive business impact. This is a hands-on role focused on model development, deployment, and optimization in real-world commercial environments.


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Data Scientist to strengthen our analytics capabilities. You will work on high-impact projects involving recommendation systems, demand forecasting, and predictive modeling using state-of-the-art techniques. The ideal candidate is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and has strong experience in model deployment within cloud environments (Azure, Databricks). You will collaborate closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data science solutions that optimize commercial performance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches)
  • Build and validate time series forecasting models using ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, and other ML-based methods
  • Implement and tune boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and decision tree-based models for classification and regression tasks
  • Perform end-to-end data exploration, feature engineering, and model evaluation
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production on Azure and Databricks
  • Translate business problems into analytical frameworks and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Stay current with emerging trends and tools in machine learning and data science



Profile Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics , or a related quantitative field


Experience & Skills:

  • Proven experience in recommender systems and time series forecasting
  • Strong expertise in boosting algorithms (XGBoost, etc.) and decision trees
  • Proficiency in Python and key libraries: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning , Databricks , and cloud-based model deployment
  • Familiarity with C++ (a plus for performance-critical components)
  • Solid understanding of ML lifecycle , from prototyping to production
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) – essential for global collaboration


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-performing analytics team driving real business impact
  • Work on cutting-edge machine learning applications in a dynamic commercial environment
  • Access to modern tools and cloud infrastructure (Azure, Databricks)
  • Opportunities for growth within the Mantu Group ecosystem

title: Analista de Business Development
description:
Quem somos nós

Na Amaris Consulting , acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

Presente em mais de 60 países e reunindo mais de 6.000 pessoas de 110 nacionalidades diferentes, atuamos em diversos setores — desde tecnologia da informação, engenharia, ciências da vida, até energia e telecomunicações.

Nosso objetivo é construir um futuro mais inteligente e sustentável, impulsionando a inovação e o crescimento de nossos clientes e de nossos talentos.


Descrição do cargo

Sua missão será criar, desenvolver e tornar rentável e sustentável a sua própria Unidade de Negócio , tendo controle operacional e estratégico sobre ela.

Para garantir o crescimento dessa estrutura, você atuará diariamente em cinco eixos principais:


Suas missões

Negócios e Estratégia

  • Gerir, coordenar e desenvolver uma Unidade de Negócio, assegurando seu crescimento.
  • Realizar um mapeamento de clientes/ofertas, tecnologias e competências do mercado com o apoio de outros departamentos internos do Grupo.
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais técnicas e financeiras estruturadas e negociar preços.
  • Preparar e conduzir reuniões de qualificação entre clientes e consultores.
  • Realizar revisões de projeto, acompanhamento e relatórios de desempenho.


Relacionamento com o Cliente

  • Monitorar as atividades dos clientes para antecipar e conquistar novos projetos.
  • Manter o portfólio de clientes atualizado e fortalecer parcerias existentes.
  • Abrir novas contas, gerenciando aspectos legais e contratuais.


Gestão Financeira

  • Analisar e otimizar o Profit & Loss (P&L), calculando margens.
  • Realizar análises avançadas de rentabilidade, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e elaborar planos de ação para otimizar faturamento e margem contributiva.
  • Gerenciar temas relacionados à recuperação de créditos.


Recursos Humanos

  • Participar do recrutamento e da gestão da equipe de consultores (prospecção, entrevistas, relatórios, assinatura de contratos etc.).
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de carreira da equipe (atribuição de funções, avaliações, envolvimento de talentos-chave etc.).
  • Antecipar e gerenciar situações de intercontrato, propondo soluções adequadas.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, com histórico de cumprimento ou superação de metas.
  • Experiência com mercado de tecnologia.
  • Forte entendimento das técnicas de vendas e do ambiente corporativo B2B.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação.
  • Fluência em português e inglês.
  • Formação superior completa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


O que oferecemos

  • Um ambiente internacional com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
  • A possibilidade de atuar diretamente com clientes de diferentes países (Estados Unidos e Europa).
  • Um modelo de negócio sólido e sustentável, com crescimento anual de 45% e mais de 400 projetos ativos no Brasil .
  • Uma cultura que valoriza o acompanhamento individual, o desenvolvimento de competências e a formação contínua .
  • Uma abordagem centrada nas pessoas — sem bodyshopping , com foco em carreira e evolução profissional .


Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

  • Desejável experiência em projetos de melhoria de processos regulatórios ou implantação de sistemas.

  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes ambientes e rotinas corporativas;
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas e execução das atividades;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;

title: Analista Comercial - Inside Sales
description:
Local: Greystar


Primeiramente, nós apresentamos:


Somos a Greystar, um conceito de apartamentos de aluguel totalmente equipados, com um serviço de gerenciamento profissional que está estabelecendo o padrão no mercado. Desde a nossa fundação, buscamos oferecer um estilo de vida exclusivo, focado em proporcionar aos nossos residentes uma experiência única.


Nosso principal objetivo? É oferecer um estilo de vida exclusivo focado em nossos residentes vivendo uma experiência única.


Somos uma empresa que tem as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos e trabalhamos com base em nossos pilares e valores; nossos pilares servem de guia para “o que fazemos” e nossos valores orientam “a forma como fazemos”. Acreditamos firmemente que a diversidade agrega valor. É por isso que nossos valores promovem um ambiente de diversidade, igualdade e inclusão, estabelecendo uma base e uma mentalidade pela qual orientamos os membros da equipe, nossos residentes, comunidades e parceiros. Somos uma empresa comprometida em criar um ótimo local de trabalho para todos e reforçamos isso com nossas iniciativas de diversidade, igualdade e inclusão.


Chamou sua atenção? Quer saber mais sobre as funções?


Perfil procurado:

  • Momento de carreira: Profissional com experiência prática em vendas e atendimento. Alguém em fase de crescimento na carreira, com energia e ambição para colaborar em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Formação e experiências anteriores: Preferencialmente com passagem por startups, ou empresas de tecnologia ligadas ao setor imobiliário principalmente de curta estadia, para entender mais do nosso dinamismo. Experiência com inside sales , atendimento digital e foco em fechamento são diferenciais.
  • Habilidades técnicas: Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de CRM, domínio do pacote Office (com foco em Excel) e boa fluência em Outlook. É essencial ter excelente escrita – clara, profissional e persuasiva, tanto para e-mails quanto para WhatsApp, além de boa comunicação presencial.
  • Comunicação e perfil comercial: Boa escuta, empatia e firmeza para negociar. Buscamos alguém com perfil closer , com habilidade para contornar objeções, ler o momento do lead e conduzi-lo até o fechamento.
  • Comportamento e atitude: Perfil colaborativo, alto astral, despojado, com senso de dono e foco em metas. Flexível e adaptável a mudanças de processo, com facilidade em lidar com tecnologia. Valoriza o trabalho em equipe, mas tem autonomia para tocar suas entregas com responsabilidade.
  • Idioma: Inglês intermediário, sendo capaz de conversar com clientes estrangeiros e explicar de forma clara o processo de locação.



Funções:

  • Gestão Comercial: Gerir o ciclo completo de vida do cliente, desde a prospecção, acompanhamento e fechamento, visando a máxima ocupação das unidades (seguindo os padrões de qualidade da empresa).
  • Visitas Comerciais: Realizar visitas comerciais aos imóveis, mostrando os apartamentos, explicando o conceito e também as áreas comuns.
  • Gestão de Clientes: Contribuir proativamente para a construção e desenvolvimento da melhor experiência para os nossos clientes, organizando eventos, remoções e atividades diversas.
  • Gestão de Indicadores: Monitorar diariamente os principais indicadores de gestão através do CRM.



Benefícios:

  • Vale Transporte
  • Cartão Alimentação Flash (flexível)
  • Remuneração variável de acordo com a política vigente.
  • Plano de Saúde – 100% subsidiado para titulares e dependentes.
  • Plano Odontológico – 100% subsidiado para titulares e dependentes.
  • Seguro de vida em grupo.
  • TotalPass.
  • Day-Off.

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de grandes contas, através das atuações porta a porta, Leads direcionados e também por construções de conexões e relacionamentos;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio;
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia;
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente;
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão;



Requisitos:

  • Possuir graduação completa;
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas
  • Ter experiência em negociar e fechar contratos;
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial (100% Externo).
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores
description:
Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores | EQI Investimentos


Você sonha em construir uma carreira sólida no mercado financeiro, transformar a vida das pessoas por meio dos investimentos e ter a chance de ser contratado pela empresa que mais cresce no mercado financeiro?

Se você está comprometido com sua evolução profissional e quer começar a trilhar um caminho de sucesso no mercado financeiro, inscreva-se agora !

title: Country Manager, Brazil
description:
A Hellotext  é a plataforma de marketing conversacional e automação que impulsiona vendas para algumas das marcas de e-commerce mais ambiciosas da América Latina. Com uma base de clientes em rápido crescimento, estamos expandindo nossa presença país por país — e o Brasil é a próxima grande prioridade .

Esta não é uma posição de suporte ou pré-vendas.

Você será a liderança comercial da Hellotext no Brasil , com foco absoluto em vendas enterprise, abertura de mercado e geração de receita .


Sua missão


Construir e escalar a operação comercial da Hellotext no Brasil , fechando as primeiras contas estratégicas, abrindo relacionamento com líderes C-Level e estabelecendo a empresa como referência em marketing conversacional para e-commerce e varejo enterprise.

Você será responsável por gerar, qualificar e fechar negócios , além de criar as bases para o crescimento futuro do país.


O que você fará


  • Liderar o go-to-market comercial da Hellotext no Brasil , com foco em vendas B2B enterprise.
  • Prospectar, desenvolver e fechar negócios com marcas médias e enterprise  de e-commerce e varejo.
  • Abrir e manter relacionamento direto com CMOs, Heads de E-commerce, Diretores Digitais e VPs .
  • Executar outbound estratégico multicanal (LinkedIn, telefone, WhatsApp, eventos, visitas presenciais).
  • Conduzir reuniões executivas, apresentações comerciais e negociações complexas .
  • Adaptar o discurso comercial, posicionamento e narrativa da Hellotext para o mercado brasileiro (PT-BR).
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Produto e Marketing para levar feedback real de mercado e influenciar roadmap.
  • Representar a Hellotext presencialmente em São Paulo, Rio, BH, Porto Alegre e outras praças estratégicas.
  • Criar as bases para futura contratação e estruturação do time local (vendas, CX, parcerias).


O que você traz


  • Experiência comprovada vendendo SaaS, MarTech ou soluções digitais  para e-commerce ou varejo no Brasil.
  • Histórico real de fechamento de negócios  (não apenas geração de leads).
  • Conforto total em conversar, negociar e vender para nível C-Level e diretoria .
  • Forte capacidade de conduzir ciclos de venda consultivos e de alto valor.
  • Português nativo e inglês intermediário-avançado.
  • Mentalidade de dono: autonomia, responsabilidade e execução sem microgestão.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (~25%) dentro do Brasil.
Diferenciais (nice-to-have)
  • Deals fechados acima de USD 30k ARR .
  • Rede ativa de contatos em e-commerce, varejo, plataformas ou ecossistemas digitais.
  • Experiência sendo o primeiro representante comercial  de uma empresa no país.
  • Vivência ajudando a estruturar times ou processos comerciais.


Competências que valorizamos


  • Venda enterprise e negociação executiva .
  • Storytelling C-Suite — traduz valor de negócio, não features.
  • Prospecção estratégica — menos volume, mais impacto.
  • Forte senso de ownership sobre receita, pipeline e resultados.
  • Capacidade de aprender rápido, testar abordagens e construir playbooks do zero.


Por que a Hellotext?


  • Produto líder, focado 100% em comércio eletrônico latino-americano.
  • Papel fundacional com impacto direto na estratégia e crescimento do Brasil.
  • Autonomia real para construir o mercado local.
  • Cultura de execução, transparência e responsabilidade.
  • Trabalho remoto no Brasil, com verba para coworking e visitas a clientes.

Realização de cronoanálise: determinar quanto tempo e esforços são necessários para a execução de cada tarefa na linha;

Desenvolvimento e melhoria de padrões de trabalho/instruções técnicas/procedimentos operacionais;

Desenvolver, executar, testar e atualizar sistemas e processos;

Desenvolver melhores práticas, rotinas e soluções inovadoras para melhorar as taxas de produção e a qualidade dos resultados;

Estudar e compreender processos e melhores práticas existentes em outras plantas da Husqvarna pelo mundo e trazer/adaptar para o Brasil.

Formação superior em engenharia (preferencialmente mecânica ou produção);

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

As a Collections Specialist, your mission is to execute recoveries hands-on while building the foundations of a scalable, fair, and data-driven collections function.

You will work directly on active cases — negotiating, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving — while also turning what you learn into clear playbooks, policies, and operating processes.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and design:

  • You recover capital today
  • You help ensure we recover it better, faster, and more predictably tomorrow


Qualifications

  • Strong experience in collections in Brazil .
  • Fluent in Portuguese and basic English.
  • Solid understanding of legal and judicial recovery frameworks .
  • Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and cohorts .
  • Ability to reason about effort vs. yield economics .
  • Working knowledge of SQL / BI tools (hands-on or close collaboration).
  • Highly execution-oriented — comfortable being in the weeds.
  • Structured thinker who turns chaos into process.
  • Clear, practical communicator with Ops, Risk, and Legal.
  • Ownership mindset — sees gaps and fills them.


Responsibilities

  • Execute collections hands-on across delinquency stages and products.
  • Manage negotiations and recoveries , including complex or sensitive cases.
  • Help design and maintain collections playbooks and policies .
  • Continuously improve case prioritization and escalation logic .
  • Partner with Data to translate execution insights into better segmentation and models.
  • Support and monitor external partners (law firms, agencies).
  • Track and communicate recovery performance and operational insights.
  • Act as a builder of the collections function , not just an operator.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.


But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Mid/Senior Android Developer
description:
TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players . Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and other international markets.


We are looking for data-driven innovators who want to shape the future of iGaming and make a real impact on the industry. We value integrity, a curious mindset, empathy, and a commitment to quality. If you are eager to learn, unafraid of challenges, and ready to grow with a like-minded team — we want to hear from you.


Responsibilities:


  • Design and build advanced applications for the Android platform.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Work with outside data sources and APIs.
  • Unit-test code for robustness, including edge cases, usability, and general reliability.
  • Work on bug fixing and improving application performance.
  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies to maximize development efficiency.


Requirements:


  • Knowledge of the Kotlin programming language is required to develop clear, legible, and maintainable code.
  • Knowledge of the Android SDK and Android Studio.
  • Practical knowledge of mobile app architecture, flow, design, implementation, and release.
  • Experience working with remote data via REST and JSON.
  • Experience with third-party libraries and APIs.
  • 3+ years of experience in native Android app development.
  • You have experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Good knowledge of English and good communication skills.
  • References and a background check can be requested from the candidate.
  • Experience working using WebSocket. 


Working with us implies:


  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.

﻿

The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: National Sales Director (Brazil)
description:
Job Title: National Sales Director - Brazil

Reports To: Head of Overseas Business Unit

Location: Brazil (Remote, frequent travel required)


Position Overview

To support the company's strategic development, we are investing significantly in the Brazilian market to accelerate brand growth, product localization, and sales network expansion. We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.


Key Responsibilities

A. Market Strategy & Planning

  1. Develop and execute the overall sales strategy, channel plan, and annual business objectives for Brazil.
  2. Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation.
  3. Rapidly expand the national sales network to ensure broad market coverage.

B. Channel Development & Management

  1. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard national distributors and key strategic partners.
  2. Manage relationships with distributors and major customers, optimizing processes and service delivery.
  3. Maintain distributor and customer profiles, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement improvement plans.

C. Brand & Marketing Promotion

  1. Develop and implement brand-building activities, including marketing campaigns, PR events, and digital outreach.
  2. Organize product demonstrations, technical trainings, and industry exhibitions to increase brand visibility.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

  1. Work closely with product, R&D, and marketing teams to share market insights and support product development.
  2. Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

E. Market & Competitive Intelligence

  1. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes to adjust strategies proactively.
  2. Prepare regular market reports and business forecasts for headquarters.


Qualifications

A. Experience

  1. Minimum 15 years of sales management experience in the baking ingredients industry, with a focus on non-dairy whipping toppings or related products, specifically in the Brazilian market.
  2. Previous experience in a similar role at companies is highly preferred.
  3. Established network of national distributors and key clients, with the ability to execute quickly.

B. Knowledge

  1. Full understanding of bakery products and familiarity with bakery operations or production processes.
  2. Proficient in Microsoft Office for data analysis, reporting, and presentation.

C. Competency

  1. Strong strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business acumen.
  2. Resilient under pressure and willing to travel frequently.
  3. Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.


We Offer

  1. Competitive compensation package.
  2. Opportunity to lead in a high-priority strategic market with significant growth potential.
  3. Full support from global headquarters in product, marketing, and technical resources.



About Hi-Road Food Technology

Shanghai Hi-road Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading integrated enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of premium bakery and catering ingredients. Committed to becoming the preferred partner in the global baking industry, we dedicate ourselves to providing customers with innovative, safe, and delicious food solutions.

With our strong independent R&D capabilities, Hi-Road meticulously sources world-class raw materials and employs advanced production technologies. Our comprehensive quality control system ensures the consistent excellence of our diverse product portfolio, which includes:

•Dairy and non-dairy toppings

•Premium fruit preparations

•Chocolate products

•Bakery creams and margarine compounds

•Flavor sauces

•Food flavors and additives

Through continuous innovation and stringent quality standards, we strive to deliver exceptional value and culinary inspiration to our partners worldwide

title: IT Helpdesk Engineer, Corporate IT
description:
Corporate IT is the backbone of our business. Our team helps the company to develop a competitive advantage through defining our technology objectives, assessing solution options, and devising technical solutions that help us achieve both strategic goals and meet operational requirements. As a part of our team, you’ll help deliver seamless IT experiences and support to our internal employees by providing responsive helpdesk service, stable networks and reliable IT systems.


As a Helpdesk Engineer, you will be responsible for implementing IT operations according to policy, interpret IT related issues on both System and User side to meet corporate requirements, and provide technical support in a fast-paced and demanding environment.


Job Description:

  • Provide day-to-day technical support to end users and ensure the smooth running of computers, network devices and printers
  • Troubleshoot and resolve end user application issues, maintain and update technical support documentation
  • Handle asset management, maintain inventory and liaise with vendors
  • Maintain and monitor office network infrastructure, IT security and antivirus tools
  • Other duties include performing first level troubleshooting and support for scheduled server backups, system monitoring and reports


Job Requirements:

  • Diploma or degree in Computer Sciences, Information Technology or a related field preferred
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience operating in a similar role
  • In-depth knowledge of computer hardware, software, and OS (Windows and macOS)
  • Understanding of TCP/IP, IP addressing and LAN technology including switching and routing fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience in Windows server administration and basic knowledge in Linux server administration is a plus
  • Professional Qualification - Microsoft Certified/CCNA is a plus
  • Knowledge of basic setup and configuration of Cisco devices such as firewall, switch, IP phones, wireless controller and access points is a plus
  • Competent at documenting standard operating procedures and knowledge articles
  • Ability to cover after-office hours and weekend support if there are any infrastructure issues or activities
  • Enthusiastic and willing to learn in a fluid and fast-paced environment
  • Passionate in IT technology and wants to make a difference with technology solutions
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively at all levels
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL


BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.


Our mission is to transform people’s lives for the better. We don’t hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.


Our message to the world is simple – make everyone’s life healthier and longer with help of BGI.


Why joining us?


Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.


Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.


Why do we want you?


We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI’s values, products and services. And that’s why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.



Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:


1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders; use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.


Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:


1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.


Competences:


a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.


Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners’ physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.


Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.


· What do we offer?


1. International, cross-cultural, and cross-functional team

2. work with advanced technology and products

3. comprehensive onboarding program

4. continuous knowledge and skills development

5. HQ organized training globally and in China

6. official permanent work agreement and all social benefits

7. annual performance bonus

8. team building activities

9. salary range BRL 7.500 - 11.500 gross monthly.


Let’s move to the brighter and more equal future together and deliver #Omicsforall

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.
